notices.type_code_home: Type this code in Home Assistant to add the panel
notices.type_code_music: Type this code in Music Assistant to add the speaker
notices.test_message: This is how the notifications you send from Home Assistant look

sheets.name: Name
sheets.device_not_available: This device is not available right now. The controls will work again when it reconnects.

settings.ambient_same_as_np: The same as “Now playing” (configuration web → 🔊 Sound).
settings.automatic_light_by: Automatic: light by day and dark at night (with sunrise and sunset)
settings.buttons_sliders_volume: For buttons, sliders and the volume bubble
settings.time_without_touching: Time without touching the screen before showing the clock
settings.time_ambient_mode: Time in ambient mode before turning it off. It turns on when touched or when a notification arrives
settings.turn_off_screen: Turn off the screen at night
settings.when_not_use: When not in use (a minute after the last touch)
settings.each_source_can: Each source can have its own in the configuration web. Whole + blurred: not cropped, with the same photo blurred behind
settings.its_controls_appear: Its controls appear at the bottom right. The first one on the list that is playing wins; if none is playing, the first paused one, otherwise the first one.
settings.none_one_playing: None: the one playing among those that open “Now playing”.
settings.choose_which_ones: Choose which ones appear under the clock (ambient mode). They only show when they have something to tell. In tabs, add them with a “Bubble row”. Edit and create them in the configuration web.
settings.there_no_assist: There is no Assist satellite in Home Assistant (e.g. a Home Assistant Voice).
settings.not_working_see: Not working (see the log in the web)
settings.chime_notifications_beeps: Chime for notifications and beeps for critical ones (volume in Sound)
settings.no_alarms_panel: No alarms. The panel will turn on the screen and ring at the time you choose.
settings.simulated_computer_image: Simulated on the computer: the image is dimmed and the hardware is not touched
settings.network_setup_from: Network and setup from your phone
settings.pi_s_wifi: The Pi's WiFi, IP and name are changed in that web, under “Pi network”.
settings.when_there_new: When there is a new version
settings.tells_update_button: It tells you and you update with the button
settings.computer_does_not: ⚠ On the computer it does not really update
settings.simulated_network_test: ℹ Simulated network (test mode on the computer)
settings.phone_setup_needs_pi: Setting up from your phone works on the Raspberry Pi, with the helper (panel-helper.py) running.
settings.scan_code: Scan the code with your phone camera (on the same WiFi)
settings.log_in_with_password: Log in with the password you set when installing the panel
settings.change_and_save: Change anything and press Save: the panel updates by itself
settings.available_on_pi: Available on the Raspberry Pi (with the panel-helper.py helper).
settings.simulated_network: 🧪 Simulated network (test mode on the computer)
settings.auto_update_hint: It updates by itself every day at that time (the panel restarts for a few seconds)
settings.sudo_hint: To install new packages without a password, run scripts/setup-kiosk.sh once on the Pi.
settings.updating_restart: Updating… the panel will restart by itself
settings.no_real_update: 🧪 On the computer it does not really update
settings.backlight_none: Not detected: brightness and turning off are done by darkening the picture
settings.backlight_no_control: Detected, but this screen cannot be controlled
settings.add_photo_sources: Add photo sources from the configuration web
settings.update_available: There is a panel update: configuration web → Updates

setup.title: Connect the panel to Home Assistant
setup.scan: Scan the code with your phone (on the same WiFi), log in with the panel password and enter the Home Assistant address and a long-lived token.
setup.config_js: Open config.js and fill in haUrl (your Home Assistant address) and token.
setup.token_where: You create the token in Home Assistant → your profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens.
setup.also_phone: With the helper (panel-helper.py) running you can also set it up from your phone.
setup.starts_by_itself: As soon as you save it, the panel will start by itself.
setup.then_reload: Then reload the panel (or restart the Pi).
setup.token_where_full: You create the token in Home Assistant → your profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens.

voice.hint: When you talk to this Assist satellite, what you say and its answer show at the bottom, over any screen.
voice.mic_error: Could not read the microphone of this panel.
voice.demo_heard: Turn on the living room light
voice.demo_reply: Done, I turned on the living room light

photos.cors: your server does not let the browser read the album (CORS) and the Pi's helper is not running
photos.not_immich: it is not an Immich link
photos.needs_key: a private album needs the API key, or use a shared link
photos.google_needs_helper: Google Photos needs the Pi's helper (panel-helper.py)

scripts.call_only_on_tap: ha.call can only be used when tapping (onTap)
scripts.needs_render: It has to return an object with render(ha, screen, config)
scripts.watch_list: watch has to be a list of entities
scripts.render_html: render has to return html`…` (or a text with HTML)

builtin.empty_the_xiaomi_scooter: Empty: the Xiaomi scooter if there is one
builtin.a_camera_or_image: A camera or image; or a sensor / input_text whose state is the address. Empty: the printer’s
builtin.better_an_image_e: Better an image (e.g. …/webcam/snapshot.jpg, it refreshes by itself); if it is a page (the player), it goes in as it is
builtin.like_the_camera_empty: Like the camera. Empty: the printer’s
builtin.empty_the_one_it: Empty: the one it finds by itself (if any)
builtin.empty_the_printer_s: Empty: the printer’s (if it has one)
builtin.home_assistant_has_no: Home Assistant has no printer data: it is off, starting or offline
builtin.show_it_if_it: Show it if it rings in less than (hours)
builtin.if_you_choose_none_2: If you choose none: all the visible ones
builtin.in_the_tabs_a: In the tabs, a button to turn them off
builtin.if_there_are_notifications: If there are notifications on the list

login.no_password_yet: There is no password yet. On the Pi run: python3 ~/ha-panel/panel-helper.py --set-password
login.could_not_connect: Could not connect to the panel

tabs.brightness_screen_off: Brightness, screen off and the network are simulated: you can try everything without changing anything on this computer.

general.what_pi_screen: What the Pi screen shows right now.
general.screen_cannot_shown: The screen cannot be shown (it only works on the Pi).
general.type_new_one: Type a new one only if you want to change it
general.security_saved_token: For security the saved token is never shown. Create it in Home Assistant → your profile → Security.
general.panel_shows_up: The panel shows up in Home Assistant as a device by itself, over MQTT (for example with the Mosquitto add-on). Nothing else to install.
general.type_new_one_only: Type a new one only if you want to change it
general.token_access_all: With a token (access to all of Home Assistant)
general.integration_only_what: With the integration (only what you choose)
general.no_token_add: No token: add the “Panel Hogar” integration in Home Assistant and, in its options, choose which entities the panel sees and controls.
general.panel_sees_controls: The panel sees and controls all of Home Assistant with a long-lived token.
general.no_connection_home: No connection with the Home Assistant integration
general.integrations_not_shown: Integrations not shown on the panel
general.only_if_not: (only if not detected; “Name = switch.x”, one per line)
general.install_panel_hogar: Install the “Panel Hogar” integration: Home Assistant finds the panel on your network by itself. When you add it, a code appears on the panel screen; type it in Home Assistant.
general.sure_will_have: Sure? It will have to be linked again
general.they_appear_quick: They appear in the quick access panel (swipe down from the top → right window). One tap turns them on or off.
general.entities_error_prefix: Could not read the list of entities:
general.entities_to_choose: {n} Home Assistant entities to choose from.

screen.automatic_light_by: (automatic: light by day, dark at night)

ambient.same_as_np_hint: (the 🔊 Sound list: you only set it up once)
ambient.first_one_list: The first one on the list that is playing wins; if none is playing, the first paused one, otherwise the first one.
ambient.shared_album_link: Shared album link: in Immich → album → Share → Create link.
ambient.google_photos_album: In Google Photos → album → Share → Create link. The Pi helper reads it.
ambient.those_marked_ambient: Those marked “Ambient” appear under the clock, in this order, only when they have something to tell. In tabs, add them with a “Bubble row” (🗂️ Tabs). Tap one to change its title and how it works.
ambient.title_new_bubble: Title of the new bubble (e.g. Living room temperature)
ambient.https_get_bubble: https://… (get a bubble from the internet)
ambient.how_write_how: How to write how it works
ambient.title: Title
ambient.fit_cover: How it looks: fill the screen
ambient.fit_blur: How it looks: whole + blurred background
ambient.no_sources: No sources: ambient mode uses a colour gradient.
ambient.key_saved: API key saved (type to change it)
ambient.folder_placeholder: Folder, e.g. photos (empty = all of “My media”)
ambient.ha_media_hint: Photos you upload to Home Assistant → Media → My media. They are only read.

sound.jack_hdmi_or: Jack, HDMI or a USB speaker.
sound.limit_music_notifications: It is the limit: music, notifications and voice never play louder. If it distorts, lower it.
sound.must_installed_once: It must be installed once on the Pi:
sound.use_pi_as: Use the Pi as a speaker
sound.music_assistant_one: The Music Assistant one created with the speaker. Automatic finds it by name.
sound.set_music_assistant: Set in Music Assistant: this speaker's player settings → delay.
sound.but_not_working: On, but not working (see the log)
sound.screen_large_cover: The screen with the large cover that appears when music plays.
sound.when_paused_or: When paused or stopped, close “Now playing”
sound.speakers_open_by: Speakers that open it, by priority
sound.when_one_starts: When one starts playing, its “Now playing” appears. If another one is shown, it only switches if the new one is higher on the list or the shown one is not playing; when it stops, it moves to the next one still playing.
sound.none_now_playing: None: “Now playing” does not open by itself
sound.none_one_playing: None: the one playing among those that open “Now playing”
sound.assist_satellite_what: (Assist satellite: what you say and its answer appear on the screen)
sound.speaker: Speaker
sound.np_ignore: Do not open it with these sources
sound.np_ignore_hint: Separated by commas. For example “TV”: a soundbar playing the TV sound does not open it.

beta.works_but_may: It works, but it may fail or change in future versions.
beta.home_assistant_added: In Home Assistant it is added with the integration
beta.voice_error_prefix: Could not read the voice assistant:

editor.each_tab_side: Each tab of the side bar with its cards, laid out as on the panel. Tap one to change it.
editor.tap_card_change: Tap a card to change it, or “+ Add”.
editor.components_are_created: Components are created and changed in 🧩 Components.
editor.what_inside_edited: What is inside is edited by tapping it in the grid.
editor.what_goes_tabs: What goes in the tabs (buttons, cards, weather…). Each one is code: it declares its fields, what it watches and what it draws. Place them in 🗂️ Tabs.
editor.created_component: Created “{name}”. You can now place it in 🗂️ Tabs.
editor.saved_not_component: Saved “{name}”, but it is not a component (it lacks type: 'card').

editor.panel_off_hint: ⓘ The panel is not on: screen (alarms, brightness…) and ha.info are empty here.
editor.restore_confirm: Go back to the built-in version? Your changes are lost.
editor.other_entity: On another entity (empty: the card's one)
editor.conditions_hidden: With conditions: it would not show now
editor.old_cards_hint: These cards take the width you choose, but look like before.
editor.panel_off_no_areas: ⚠ The panel is not on: no areas.
editor.tabs_built: The tabs have been built with components.
editor.sure_lose_yours: Sure? Yours are lost. Tap again
editor.bubbles_error_prefix: Could not read how the bubbles work:
editor.removed_from_rows_one: (and removed from {n} row of bubbles in the tabs)
editor.removed_from_rows: (and removed from {n} rows of bubbles in the tabs)
editor.sure_used: Sure? It is used in {n} place(s). Tap again
editor.component_code_in: Component {name}: its code is in 🧩 Components.
editor.panel_off_no_areas_text: ⚠ The panel is not on: no areas.

system.backup_password_hint: Without a password the Home Assistant token and the passwords do not go in (restoring keeps the ones on this Pi). With one, everything goes in, encrypted; without it the backup cannot be restored: keep it safe.
system.backup_hint: Settings, tabs, bubbles, your scripts and the speaker, voice and sound options in one file.
system.backup_sure: Tap again: it replaces the current settings
system.set_static_ip: Set a static IP if you want this web's address to never change.
system.one_address_http: It is the one in the address http://<name>.local:8080
system.simulated_network_changes: Simulated network: changes show here but do not touch the computer's network.
system.notify_me_i: Notify me (I update with the button)
system.update_by_itself: Update by itself every day at a time
system.better_at_night: Better at night: the panel restarts for a few seconds when updating.
system.so_can_install: So it can install system packages a new version needs, run once again
system.no_networkmanager: This device does not use NetworkManager: only the information is shown.
system.back_to_dhcp: Go back to the automatic IP? The address may change.
system.restarting_new: Restarting the panel with the new version…
system.update_confirm: Update now? The panel will restart for a few seconds.
system.networks_found: {n} networks found. Tap one to connect.
system.connect_confirm: Connect the Pi to “{ssid}”? If the password is wrong, the Pi may lose the network until you connect it again by hand.
system.static_ip_confirm: Set the static IP {ip}? Then you will have to go to http://{ip}:8080
system.sudo_hint: So it can install the system packages a new version needs, run this once on the Pi:
